You are here:Ph.D. Medical Research
Ph.D. Medical Research
If you have a degree in medicine, veterinary medicine, natural sciences, pharmacy, health sciences or a related subject, then the Ph.D. Medical Research may be right for you.
Ph.D. Medical Research
The Ph.D. Medical Research is a structured doctoral program of at least three years with a total of 180 ECTS (30 ECTS curriculum, 140 ECTS project and 10 ECTS disputation). The target group is graduates in medicine, veterinary medicine, natural sciences, pharmacy, health sciences or a related subject.
Core areas, IRTGs & Co.
There are 6 different core areas and multiple associated training programs that offer Ph.D projects.
Read more
Requirements and application
The faculty emphasizes the high quality standards of all PhD projects and selects applicants carefully.
Read more
Registration for the Ph.D. Medical Research
You can only register for the Ph.D. Medical Research after your application has been accepted.
Read more
The most important steps of your Ph.D. project
A 3-member committee (TAC) accompanies your project and regularly documents the progress in TAC meetings.
Read more
Curriculum and courses
At least 3 years of full-time research work and a curriculum with 30 ECTS are required for the Ph.D.
Read more
Submitting your dissertation
Once you have reached all the milestones of your Ph.D. project, you can submit your dissertation.
Read more
The review of your dissertation
2 reviews and 2 statements will be obtained for your dissertation.
Read more
The defense of your dissertation
The defense is a scientific debate with your examination committee.
Read more
Publication of your statutory copies and your doctoral certificate
After you have published your statutory copies, you will receive your doctoral certificate.
